title: Jezero field excursion

stops.title: Surface contact
stops.question: Does the surface texture change across this contact?
stops.context: Compare grain size, angularity, and texture on either side. This is a proposed observation, not a confirmed mapped geologic boundary.

stops.title: Relief transect
stops.question: How does local relief relate to the material exposed?
stops.context: Record an outcrop sketch and compare visible texture with the elevation profile. Orbital slope does not resolve individual boulders.

stops.title: Thermal context
stops.question: Can field observations explain the regional IR-brightness pattern?
stops.context: Compare loose and coherent surface materials. The coarse daytime mosaic alone cannot establish composition, temperature, or thermal inertia.

brief: Compare surface textures and relief within an archival HiRISE patch of Jezero. Every field station and the habitat are hypothetical.
regionalContext: Jezero contains an ancient delta investigated by Perseverance. These demonstration stops are not claimed to be rover-visited sites or delta outcrops.
